en-US.whatsNew:
## Update

Click **Update** in AnkiBase (Settings → Server), or run this on the server:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Macro002/AnkiBase/main/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --update
```
With Docker, where your `docker-compose.yml` is: `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`

**Android:** download the `.apk` below and open it. It installs over the old version.

**iPhone:** add the source `https://apps.macr0.dev/static/ios/source.json` in SideStore or AltStore and update

apps.description: Matterleast is an unofficial Android client for Mattermost servers that tries to have a feel closer to Discord. Features - Discord-style feel and navigation: you can swipe between chats, swipe on messages to react/reply etc. - One Home inbox across all servers for unread messages, mentions, threads and saved messages - Notifications without Google's push service via a background job - Tablet layout in landscape - Different theming options: Matterleast colours, your Mattermost theme or Material You Other (obvious) features that exist: threads, reactions, file previews, sharing, search, custom emojis, bots, channel management and more. Limitations - Calls, Playbooks and Boards are not supported, nor are Apps framework forms and message translation. - Notifications don't go through Mattermost's push proxy, so new messages arrive when the app checks (about every 15 minutes) unless "Stay connected" is on. To use this app, you need the address of a Mattermost server and an account on it. The app talks to that server and, depending on its settings and the messages you open, to other hosts such as link previews, images and the server's plugins. Since these services aren't necessarily free software, it's labeled with "NonFreeNet". This app is significantly vibe-coded / created using LLMs. Most of its code has not been thoroughly reviewed by a human. Matterleast is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mattermost, Inc. Mattermost is a trademark of Mattermost, Inc.

apps.description: Notality is a very simple note taking app. I mostly built it to learn how Flutter works, but it's functional and you can use it. Features - Create, edit, delete and reorder notes - Automatic dark/light mode depending on the system-wide setting - Import/Export your notes to save them externally - Localization for English and German

apps.description: Rock It! helps you stay informed on all things space. It displays upcoming rocket launches and current space news curated by The Space Devs. Features - List upcoming launches and events (e.g. space station activity) - Show launch/event details and a countdown (including the date and time in your local timezone) - List latest space news articles - Subscribe to launches or events to receive notifications before the start or when times are updated - Search future events and launches - No internet? No problem! The app caches offline content for a few days and updates it when connected to the internet The app connects to the Launch Library and Spaceflight News API to get information about launches. Additionality, it might connect to other hosts (e.g. YouTube) to receive video and article thumbnails. Since none of these services are free software, it's labeled with "NonFreeNet".
apps.name: Rock It!
apps.summary: Rock It! is an Android app that helps you stay informed on all things space

- Crewed launches now show who is flying, with photo, role and agency
